name: Carlos Mendoza
summary: Neighbor who repairs bikes and offered to help with moving using his pickup truck.

facts.value: help moving with his pickup truck

notes.text: Carlos Mendoza lives two doors down on 4th Street. Fixes bikes in his garage for half the neighborhood, he trued my wheel for free. Has a pickup truck and said he can help when I move out in December, just bring beer. Works night shifts as a forklift operator at the port.
